phase: 2026-10-30 follow-up; earlier 16-connection comparison remains intermediate evidence

contracts.transport: k6 volatile contiguous receive/hash/window ACK; never durable APPLIED
contracts.durable: SQLite FULL projection+dedupe+cursor commit before ACK; process-restart and independent DB audit

exploration.note: Adaptive boundary search, not full Cartesian product. An admission cap is a configured bound, not hardware capacity. Stop growth only on measured generator/host/server limits. Keep failed and overloaded runs.

budgets.note: Heap/body envelopes are not RSS or OS CPU quotas. Report actual total gateway+broker+DB CPU/RSS and generator/host separately. Dual gateway plus broker uses same planned heap budget; overage is reported, not hidden.

comparison.selection: Require unchanged correctness and complete accepted obligations. Prefer structural alternative when it materially reduces query amplification or improves sustainable accepted throughput/tail/recovery under the same budget. Evaluate CPU, RSS, network, rejection, backlog and operational complexity together. Do not change latency goals or remove failed arrivals after observing results.
comparison.candidate: Bounded room-level coalescing of concurrently requested immutable pages, with fresh coherent F/head/body snapshot, authorized subscription grants and fair recovery scheduling; no durable dependence on cache.

distributed: RabbitMQ C room routing, one bounded exclusive queue per gateway, drop-head, bounded prefetch; real two processes, publisher confirm+mandatory return, one transport recovery owner, desired bindings and transport epoch, independent primary-head recovery. No physical HA claim.
